_doc: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database takes cut into game clips (cmu2glb.py). file = subject_take; f0..f1 = source frames at 120 a second; face = how the clip is turned to face +Z (mean / start / a frame number = the pelvis; {aim: frame, hand} = the striking hand's direction at that frame); loop.blend = frames cross-faded to close the cycle. Licence: http://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/ (free for all uses, may be included in commercially-sold products, may not be resold as data).
